signature.what: every line starting `**Signed by Sergi:` in PLAN_CORRECTIONS.md, of which there must be at least 1. A gate that stopped at the first would report ok over an unsigned amendment.

expectation.what: of the rules born after their run's first gateway, at least half are above a gateway at the run's end
of the rules above a gateway at the end, at least half entered own_wins
of the rules above a gateway at the end, at least half are at a depth of two or more
of the declared edges from a door into a gateway at the end, at least half are door_win
at least half of the points of the pairs through a gateway are in pairs whose newborn shares no point with any of the pair's gateways
in N r3, of the rules born after its gateway, at least half are above it at the run's end
